scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && vitest run tests/unit tests/integration
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
